laws: SourceRef stores DOI, locator, URL, and content hash.
ReportedDatum stores a source and payload but has no Coe or CoeSort instance to its payload or Prop.
No arbitrary transformation API preserves provenance without a separate proof.
description: Immutable source-addressed data records that never become experimental truth by coercion.

laws: Mass readings reuse ChemistryLib Quantity at the Physlib mass dimension.
Expected and observed displayed decimal precision are recorded independently.
Product form is metadata and may explicitly be unspecified; a mass observation carries no identity or purity proposition.
Mass residual is only the absolute difference of the two displayed dalton values and is nonnegative.
description: Dimension-indexed, narrowly interpreted expected/observed mass records with faithful display precision.

laws: MassAgreementCert has an explicit nonnegative tolerance and proves only residual boundedness.
ALFALFA-CONH2's transcribed 750.43/750.43 fields have residual zero.
A table maximum becomes deductive only after every row is bounded and some row attains it; the reported 0.193 value alone is not such a proof.
A checked 0.193 Da maximum entails a 0.2 Da row bound.
description: Mass-agreement certificates expose exactly the arithmetic proved and no molecular conclusion.

laws: Exactly 25 Supplementary Figure 8 rows are indexed by Fin 25.
Every row carries a SourceRef locator, expected and observed masses, independent displayed precisions, and an explicitly unstated product form.
Lean independently checks every absolute residual, proves entry 14 attains 0.193 Da, and proves all rows are within 0.2 Da.
empirical_inputs: 25 expected/observed mass rows enumerated in family3-source-data.json
description: A fully transcribed, provenance-addressed 25-row table and closed maximum-residual certificate.

laws: UVFeature stores only nonnegative area, full width at half maximum, and height fields.
RelativePeakIntensity and CrudeYieldObservation are distinct Lean structures with no coercion between them.
At the recorded 90 C conditions, the two reported M-18 relative peak intensities satisfy the exact arithmetic 45 / 7.5 = 6.
No theorem derives yield, purity, identity, coupling success, or statistical comparability from UV or relative-peak records.
empirical_inputs: 20 percent piperidine and 45 percent relative M-18 intensity
2.5 percent piperazine and 7.5 percent relative M-18 intensity
description: Narrow analytical observation types and one exact reported-intensity ratio, without optical or chemical overinterpretation.
